name: Department of Humanities and Management, Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology (NIT) Jalandhar

cutoffs.note: Floor from the institute's standing MBA Regulations (also in its MBA admission FAQ, PDF dated 2022): percentile below 40 in CAT/GMAT/CMAT/MAT not considered. The 2026-28 advertisement (No. 01/2026, 20.02.2026, https://nitj.ac.in/files/1771821717236-MBA_ADMISSION_ADVERTISEMENT_(REGULAR_CATEGORY)_2026_2028.pdf) uses the same 70% percentile weighting but does not restate the 40 floor. Same floor for all categories.
cutoffs.quote: The weightage for the percentile for CAT/GMAT/CMAT/MAT is given below. Percentile Scores below 40 will not be considered for admission.

statusNote: Standing regulation, not a batch-specific notice; the 2026-28 advertisement does not repeat the floor. Treat as lower-confidence.
